::: {.callout-note .se-question appearance="simple"}
## The question

[How to supply images to documents unpacked by l3build](https://tex.stackexchange.com/questions/623511/how-to-supply-images-to-documents-unpacked-by-l3build), asked by [Matthew Leingang](https://tex.stackexchange.com/users/1402/matthew-leingang) on TeX Stack Exchange (2021-11-22; [CC BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)):

> I have an module that I want to manage with l3build.  Unpacking a docstrip file generates a tex file.  `l3build doc` typesets that generated tex file.  But I can't figure out how to configure `build.lua` to enable that process to see any images that should be included.
>
> My MWE is four files (all in a [Github repo][q-1] for ease)
>
> **file tree**
>
> ```latex
> ├── build.lua
> ├── foo.dtx
> ├── foo.ins
> └── support
>     └── duck.png
> ```
>
> **`foo.dtx`**
>
> ```latex
> %<*foo>
> \documentclass{article}
> \usepackage{graphicx}
> \usepackage{lipsum}
> \begin{document}
> \lipsum[1]
> \includegraphics[
>     width=\textwidth,
> %<bar>angle=180,
> ]{duck}
> \end{document}
> %</foo>
> ```
>
> **`foo.ins`**
>
> ```latex
> \input docstrip.tex
> \askforoverwritefalse
> \generate{\file{bar.tex}{\from{\jobname.dtx}{foo,bar}}}
> \endbatchfile
> ```
>
> So `bar.tex` has one extra line, which should rotate the image 180
> degrees.
>
> **`build.lua`**
>
> ```latex
> module = "foo"
>
> typesetsuppfiles = {"duck.png"}
> typesetfiles = {"foo.dtx","bar.tex"}
> ```
>
> **duck.png**
>
> [![duck][q-2]][q-2]
>
> Command:
>
> ```latex
> l3build doc foo
> ```
>
> * `duck.png` is copied into `typesetdir`
> * `foo.dtx` is typeset in `typesetdir` (I think)
> * result: success.  `foo.pdf` is moved into `maindir`.
>
> Command:
>
> ```latex
> l3build doc bar
> ```
>
> * `bar.tex` is unpacked into `unpackdir`
> * `tex` is run on `bar.tex` in `unpackdir`
> * result: failure because `duck.png` is not found.
>
>
>   [q-1]: https://github.com/leingang/test-l3build-doc-images/tree/master
>   [q-2]: BkFhn.png
:::

I submitted an [issue][1] to the l3build github and it has been fixed.  Thanks Joseph and Marcel!


  [1]: https://github.com/latex3/l3build/issues/210
